payload.comment: Training stage is healthy and internally consistent. No deterministic findings. Key verifications: (1) ResNet18 with hidden=48 correctly sets base channel width; depth=3 is inert per fixed-topology rule. (2) Transformer fields (num_heads, patch_size, mlp_ratio, tokenizer_layers, pooling, positional_encoding) are present but inactive for the CNN family—correct. (3) Augmentations (hflip, rotate180) are built-in primitives requiring no extension approval. (4) Data audit fully passed: official split confirmed (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180), zero overlap, zero duplicates, zero blank images. (5) Training dynamics are sound: monotonic loss decrease (0.733→0.497), val accuracy rising to 0.9964 at epoch 14, cosine LR schedule decaying to 0, no overfitting signal (train and val losses both decreasing). (6) Early stopping patience=3 was not triggered; best epoch 14 with one additional epoch completed—normal. (7) Checkpoint and config hashes are recorded for traceability. Minor documentation notes (non-blocking): the prior-art brief's citation of 82,763 train samples should be corrected to the verified 89,996; llm_model_digest is null for ollama/qwen3.8 limiting full reproducibility pinning; the best_configuration.validation_accuracy (0.994002) differs slightly from the full-training best_val_accuracy (0.996401), consistent with selection-trial vs. full-run variance and not an error. The redundant extension-gate entry 'hflip_pathology_safe' and the truncated compact_conv_token_transformer description are documentation hygiene items for the record. None of these affect the training outcome. Proceed to evaluation.
llm_issues: Prior-art brief cites 82,763 as PathMNIST train split; verified data confirms 89,996. Documentation correction needed (non-blocking).
llm_model_digest is null for ollama/qwen3.8; exact model weights not pinned for full reproducibility verification.
best_configuration.validation_accuracy (0.994002) differs from train_result.best_val_accuracy (0.996401); consistent with selection-trial vs full-run variance but should be annotated for clarity.
Extension-gate entry 'hflip_pathology_safe' (pending_review) is redundant since hflip is a built-in primitive; recommend removing or clarifying.
compact_conv_token_transformer description field is truncated in the prior-art brief; restore for downstream readability.

Test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) originates from a different clinical center; OOD generalization should be monitored during evaluation. OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
